task.title: Filter deterministic corpus samples by example type
task.objective: Add an exact positive or negative schema-v1 filter without weakening complete validation, deterministic ordering, or post-filter limits
acceptance_criteria: The example option accepts exactly positive or negative
Example and trust filters compose conjunctively
Empty matches emit an empty JSON array
Invalid records anywhere suppress stdout even when they would not match
Filtering remains read-only, path ordered, and deterministic

attempts.summary: Added focused regressions for positive, negative, conjunctive, empty-match, invalid-value, and fail-closed behavior
attempts.diagnostic: The focused regression failed because the example option was not recognized

attempts.summary: Added a typed CLI value, mapped it to schema ExampleType, and applied the exact predicate after validation
Added a direct positive-selection assertion after independent review identified a low-severity coverage gap
attempts.diagnostic: The original regressions lacked a direct positive-only match assertion

outcome.summary: Corpus samples can now be filtered by typed example metadata after complete validation and before limiting
